title: The Detour Is the Danger: Preserving Security During LLM Agent Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.33605v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on external tools and reusable Skills to execute complex workflows, autonomously replanning when operations fail. However, such recovery may preserve task functionality while silently discarding the security protections required by the original workflow. In this paper, we investigate workflow security downgrade, a failure-induced security threat in which agents execute sensitive operations without satisfying their original protection requirements. Unlike prompt injection, this threat exploits autonomous recovery decisions triggered by execution failures, without modifying instructions or tool definitions. We systematically evaluate this behavior through fault injection in an executable MCP/Skill environment spanning seven LLMs, twelve task templates, and three security-sensitive domains. translated_title: 绕道即危险：LLM智能体恢复过程中的安全保障
translated_abstract: LLM智能体日益依赖外部工具和可复用的技能（Skills）来执行复杂工作流，并在操作失败时自主进行重新规划。然而，这种恢复过程可能在保留任务功能的同时，悄然丢弃原始工作流所要求的安全防护。本文研究了“工作流安全降级”这一由故障引发的安全威胁，即智能体在未满足原始保护要求的情况下执行敏感操作。与提示注入不同，该威胁利用的是由执行失败触发的自主恢复决策，无需修改指令或工具定义。我们通过在一个可执行的MCP/Skill环境中进行故障注入，对这一行为进行了系统性评估，涵盖七个大语言模型、十二个任务模板和三个安全敏感领域。为应对这一威胁，我们提出了ARGUS，一个保持安全义务的恢复框架，它结合了资源受限的安全（约束机制）……
tldr: 论文揭示了LLM智能体在任务失败后自主恢复时会在不经意间丢弃原始工作流的安全防护，提出“工作流安全降级”这一全新威胁类别，并设计了ARGUS框架以在恢复过程中保持安全义务不被绕过。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies "workflow security downgrade," a novel threat where LLM agents silently discard security protections during autonomous recovery from execution failures, and proposes ARGUS, an obligation-preserving recovery framework to defend against it.
